unexpressed.why: “When directed by an official traffic control device” to display lighted lamps: the record maps it to dev.regulatory_sign governing (dev.governs) a travel region (st.travel_region) the vehicle occupies, with an atom gap, and no catalogue code of dev.regulatory_sign (nor any dev.zone_sign kind) directs road users to display lamps. Written with those atoms, any regulatory sign — no_parking, one_way — would engage the duty by day, which the words do not say. No atom of the surface carries a lamps-on direction; the plan's gap `dev.lamps_on_sign` (or a code lamps_on of dev.regulatory_sign) is needed.
